services.name: 17th Annual Thames River Cruise
services.desc: The Annual Thames River Cruise is possible thanks to our partnership with Cross Sound Ferry. Their generosity provides the ferry boat, Cecelia Ann and all the crew and fuel costs. Additionally, they donate the two free drink tickets to passengers at check-in. We truly appreciate their support! THANK YOU! A big THANK YOU to our additional sponsors Thames River Gallery, The Mohegan Tribe, Mohegan Sun, CorePlus Credit Union DBA Scient Federal Credit Union and Noble Smokehouse. Sponsorship opportunities are still available! Email info@nlchs.org for more

blurb: As a Special Collection and Archive, the Shaw Mansion is not run as a historic house museum. We do have a few rooms which are interpreted and an exhibit room. If you wish a tour, you may arrange one by emailing info@nlchs.org. Additionally our archivists are checking email and responding to inquiries via the email research@nlchs.org.
